# PICO8-OS settings. Edit on any PC; changes apply when PICO-8 restarts.
# Lines are KEY=VALUE. Quote values that contain spaces or '#'.

# Language of the settings screen and the web UI:
#   en ko zh ja fr es ru it de
LANGUAGE=en

# What to start: splore | run | editor
PICO8_MODE=splore
# With PICO8_MODE=run: cart file inside carts/
PICO8_CART=

# What happens when you quit PICO-8: restart | poweroff | shell
EXIT_ACTION=restart

# Keyboard layout (Linux console keymap name), e.g.
#   us  uk  de  de-latin1  fr  fr-latin1  es  it  se-latin1  no  dk
#   fi  pt-latin1  br-abnt2  ch-de_nodeadkeys  jp106  dvorak
# Korean keyboards use the US layout (us).
KEYMAP=us

# Extra PICO-8 command line options, e.g. -pixel_perfect 1
PICO8_ARGS=

# auto (prefer HDMI) | none | ALSA card number or name
AUDIO_CARD=auto
# SDL video driver (kmsdrm is the only one built in)
VIDEO_DRIVER=kmsdrm

# Hardware watchdog: reboot automatically if the system hangs (on | off)
WATCHDOG=on

# Force-restart a frozen PICO-8 (on | off):
#   keyboard: Ctrl + Alt + Backspace    gamepad: hold SELECT + START 3 s
HOTKEY=on

# Bluetooth controllers (on | off). Paired controllers reconnect by
# themselves. To pair one, press Ctrl+Alt+P (or use the settings screen or
# web UI) and put the controller in pairing mode within 90 s; the first
# controller found is paired and the window closes. BT_PAIR_SECONDS > 0
# also opens such a window after every boot (off by default: anyone nearby
# could pair then).
#   PS4/PS5: hold SHARE/CREATE + PS   Switch Pro/Joy-Con: SYNC button
#   Xbox One/Series: hold the pair button   8BitDo: its pairing combo
BLUETOOTH=on
BT_PAIR_SECONDS=0

# Online updates: <OTA_URL>/latest-<board>.txt (see README). Empty = off.
# GitHub Releases: https://github.com/<user>/<repo>/releases/latest/download
OTA_URL=

# CPU frequency policy while playing: performance | ondemand | schedutil
CPU_GOVERNOR=performance

# ---- Read on the FIRST boot only ----
# The settings below (Wi-Fi, web password, PICO8_VERIFY, DEBUG) are moved
# into the console's protected storage on the first boot and removed from
# this file, so games cannot read or change them. Later, change them in
# the web UI, or put a file named pico8os-setup.txt with the same lines on
# the PICOBOOT drive: it is read (and deleted) at the next boot.

# Wi-Fi for Splore (Pi Zero W, 3, 4, 5). Ethernet works without settings.
WIFI_SSID=
WIFI_PSK=
WIFI_COUNTRY=KR

# Web UI password (user "pico"). Empty = generated on first boot; it is shown
# in the settings screen (Ctrl+Alt+S, or hold SELECT for 2 s).
WEB_PASSWORD=

# Only install PICO-8 builds on PICO8-OS's signed list of verified builds
# (strict), or also unlisted versions with a warning (warn). Damaged or
# modified files are always refused.
PICO8_VERIFY=strict

# Root shell on the serial console and tty1 for troubleshooting (on | off).
# Leave off: anyone with the console then has full control.
DEBUG=off
